captions.detailed: This 3D model features a modern desk task lamp with a multi-jointed, adjustable arm structure. It stands on a heavy, rectangular black base. The arm is constructed of dual cylindrical metallic silver rods divided into lower and upper segments by black hinge joints. At the top of the arm, a conical white reflector shade is attached, which can tilt to direct light as needed.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an adjustable desk task lamp using CadQuery. The lamp should feature a heavy rectangular black base, a dual-rod silver metal arm split into lower and upper segments by black hinges, and a tilting white conical lampshade. Ensure the joints are modeled as revolute articulations for realistic movement.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using an assembly of parts. The base is created using nested Box primitives. The lower and upper arm segments are modeled using pairs of Cylinder primitives representing the parallel metallic rods, which are connected via hinge blocks modeled from Box and Cylinder primitives. The lampshade is modeled as a hollow cone (or modified cylinder/sphere combination) to act as a light reflector. All components are positioned and oriented using rigid transforms and connected with revolute joint articulations.
